formulations.name: Triphala Churna
formulations.preparation_method: Equal parts of Amalaki, Bibhitaki (Terminalia bellirica), and Haritaki (Terminalia chebula) dried powders blended through a 64-mesh sieve.
therapeutic_uses: Eye and oral hygiene wash (kajjala, mukaroga)
formulations.dosage: 3-6 g at bedtime with warm water; external wash 5 g/litre decoction
formulations.regulatory_notes: Listed in Formulary of Ayurvedic Pharmacopoeia of India Part-1 Vol-III; Schedule T manufacturing rules apply.
formulations.schedule_t_ref: Drugs & Cosmetics Act, Schedule T - classical formulation monograph
formulations.ip_notes: Compositions and uses are heavily TKDL-documented; novelty claims on plain triphala blends have been refused by USPTO/EPO citing traditional art.
formulations.safety_notes: May cause loose stools at high dose; avoid in pregnancy without supervision.

formulations.name: Chyawanprash
formulations.preparation_method: 40+ herbs cooked into a base of fresh amla pulp, jaggery, ghee and sesame oil per the classical praskarana vidhi of Charaka Samhita.
formulations.dosage: 1-2 tsp twice daily, typically morning and night
formulations.regulatory_notes: Classical avaleha under Schedule T; multiple branded proprietary variants require separate FSSDB/AYUSH license disclosure of composition.
formulations.schedule_t_ref: Schedule T classical monograph; proprietary versions declare as 'Ayurvedic Unani Siddha' food/drug
formulations.ip_notes: The exact multi-herb composition is prior art in TKDL (Charaka Samhita Kalpa Sthana); trademark (not patent) is the main IP lever for brands like Dabur/Emami.
formulations.safety_notes: High sugar content - diabetics should use sugar-free variants; contains ghee/jaggery caloric load.

formulations.name: Ashwagandharishta
formulations.preparation_method: Fermented liquid preparation: ashwagandha kwatha combined with jaggery and dhataki self-generated alcohol fermentation over weeks per classical arista vidhana.
formulations.dosage: 10-20 ml after meals, once or twice daily
formulations.regulatory_notes: Self-generated alcohol permitted up to label-declared limits under Schedule T / AYUSH licensing.
formulations.schedule_t_ref: Schedule T arista manufacturing requirements incl. clarity and alcohol assay
formulations.ip_notes: Manufacture process described in classical texts is TKDL-indexed; export markets may restrict due to ethanol content.
formulations.safety_notes: Contains natural ethanol - caution with disulfiram-like drugs, liver disease, and driving.

formulations.name: Neem Taila (external)
formulations.preparation_method: Nimba leaves/paste processed with sesame oil and water decoction (taila paka vidhi) until moisture evaporates.
formulations.regulatory_notes: Marketed as topical ayurvedic drug; cosmetic claims trigger CDSCO vs cosmetics notification split.
formulations.ip_notes: Azadirachtin extraction patents exist but traditional topical use predates them; neem compositions form a dense TKDL cluster.
formulations.safety_notes: External use only for traditional taila; ingestion of neem oil is dangerous especially for children.

formulations.name: Arjunarishta
formulations.preparation_method: Arjuna bark kwatha fermented with jaggery and dhataki pushpa per classical arista procedures.
therapeutic_uses: Vascular and lipid support in modern adjunct practice
formulations.regulatory_notes: Classical arista; health claims about heart disease cannot be made without clinical evidence under AYUSH advertising rules.
formulations.ip_notes: TKDL documents arjuna's cardiac indications from Sarangadhara Samgita; blocks patent claims on 'new' cardiac utility.
formulations.safety_notes: Self-generated alcohol present; monitor interactions with antihypertensives.

formulations.name: Triphala Guggulu
formulations.preparation_method: Triphala churna and pungent guggulu resin (shodhita) ground with trikatu and pipppali base, granulated into tablets.
formulations.dosage: 2 tablets twice daily with warm water/milk after meals
formulations.regulatory_notes: Guggulu preparations must use purified (shodhita) resin; heavy-metal impurity limits enforced by AYUSH certification.
formulations.schedule_t_ref: Schedule T vati monograph with guggulu shuddhi requirement
formulations.ip_notes: Classic yoga documented in Bhaishajya Ratnavali indexed in TKDL; guggulipid cholesterol patents faced TKDL-based rejections.
formulations.safety_notes: Avoid in pregnancy; guggulu may interact with thyroid medications.
